reviewed_records.label: Sparkles
reviewed_records.depicts: A cluster of sparkle stars with one larger central shine.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon can mean delight, enhancement, magic, polish, novelty, or AI-assisted improvement depending on context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show something enhanced, polished, special, or newly elevated rather than a hard product status.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to signal enhancement, polish, premium treatment, or a special highlighted state.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for success, warning, failure, or any hard status where the sparkle shape would be too vague.

reviewed_records.label: Send
reviewed_records.depicts: A paper-plane style arrow used for outbound sending.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon is clearly outbound and action-oriented, though it can overlap with submit or share in some products.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show an outbound send, submit, or dispatch action for messages, content, or requests.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user is sending a message, submitting content, or dispatching something outward from the interface.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for generic navigation, status feedback, or file export when the action is not actually an outbound send.

reviewed_records.label: Filter
reviewed_records.depicts: A funnel shape that narrows content into a smaller output.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The funnel shape is a standard filter control and reads clearly in interface use.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show filtering or refinement of results, content, or data.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user can narrow, refine, or filter a list, search result, or data view.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for funnel analytics, ingestion pipelines, or generic status meaning when the UI is not actually filtering results.

reviewed_records.label: Link
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon can mean hyperlink, attachment, connection between records, or relationship between items depending on surrounding UI.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a link, connection, or relationship between two items or destinations.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product refers to a hyperlink, a connected record, or an explicit relationship between items.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for syncing, sending, or sharing when the meaning is not actually about linkage or relation.

reviewed_records.label: Refresh
reviewed_records.depicts: Two curved arrows forming a circular refresh loop.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon can overlap with sync or retry language, but in product interfaces it most commonly reads as a refresh or reload control.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show refreshing or reloading the current view, results, or content state.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user or system is refreshing a page, refetching results, or reloading the current content state.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for undo, long-running sync status, or retry-after-error flows when those meanings need a more specific icon.

reviewed_records.label: Delete
reviewed_records.depicts: A trash bin used for discard or deletion.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon is strongly associated with delete and discard actions in interface design.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show delete, discard, or remove actions for content or items.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the user can delete, discard, or remove an item from the current context.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for archive, close, or hide when the action is reversible or not truly destructive.

reviewed_records.label: Bolt
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon can mean power, electricity, speed, instant action, or special boost depending on context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show speed, energy, instant effect, or power-related intensity when the surrounding context makes that meaning clear.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product intentionally wants to signal speed, instant effect, or energy-like intensity.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for success, warning, or system power controls when a more specific icon would communicate the meaning better.

reviewed_records.label: Flame
reviewed_records.depicts: A flame with a smaller inner flame shape.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon can mean heat, popular, streak, intensity, danger, or burning resource depending on context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show heat, intensity, streak, or high-engagement energy when the product context supports that reading.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product intentionally wants to highlight intensity, momentum, or a hot/high-engagement state.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for literal danger, warning, or destructive heat unless the interface truly means fire or hazard.

reviewed_records.label: Thinking
reviewed_records.depicts: A stylized brain with left and right lobe detail.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon can mean intelligence, human thinking, psychology, memory, or AI depending on context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show thinking, cognition, intelligence, or mental processing when the product context makes the meaning specific enough.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs a broad thinking or intelligence symbol and nearby context makes the intended meaning explicit.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for precise AI workflow states or mental health topics when a more specific icon would reduce ambiguity.

reviewed_records.label: Reasoning And Tuning
reviewed_records.depicts: A brain shape with a small gear inside it.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The gear narrows the meaning more than a plain brain icon, but the record can still drift between AI reasoning, thinking systems, and configuration.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show reasoning combined with system tuning, automated thinking, or configurable intelligence behavior.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product needs to show reasoning plus tuning, configurable intelligence, or automated cognitive behavior.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for plain settings, generic AI branding, or human psychology where the combined brain-and-gear meaning would be too fuzzy.

reviewed_records.label: Compute Architecture
reviewed_records.depicts: A rounded square board with circuit nodes and traces.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The icon clearly signals compute or system logic. It is broader than one exact backend component, but it still reads consistently as technical infrastructure.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show compute architecture, system infrastructure, or low-level processing logic.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product refers to compute infrastructure, technical architecture, backend processing, or system-level logic.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for generic AI reasoning, workflow orchestration, or simple settings where the board metaphor would feel too infrastructure-heavy.

reviewed_records.label: Search Code
reviewed_records.depicts: A magnifying-glass circle with code brackets inside it.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: The code brackets make the meaning clearly developer-focused rather than generic search.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show code search, source inspection, or developer lookup over code or markup.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to search, inspect, or explore code, source, or markup.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for generic search, document lookup, or AI reasoning where the code-specific meaning would be too narrow.
